full_prompt_en: A square aged black-and-white staged photograph shows a masked jester seated in a cramped room crowded with pictures, sculptural objects, and dark furnishings. The background is layered with faded walls, framed images leaning at the left, and indistinct mannequin-like forms rising behind the central figure. The jester sits cross-legged in the middle, facing outward with one cheek propped on a hand. A pale theatrical face or mask has dark arched eye shapes and a small severe mouth; a two-pointed dark cap rises above it. Ruffled pale fabric surrounds the shoulders and sleeves, contrasting with darker gloves, fitted legs, and boots that cross across the lower foreground. The costume is wrinkled and textured rather than crisp, with each light fold catching a silvery highlight. To the left, stacked frames and a small portrait-like image crowd the edge; to the right, a low dark table and strange rounded objects interrupt the space. A shadowy face-like form is visible farther back, but it stays blurred and subordinate to the seated figure. The cramped overlap of props gives little open floor or wall, making the central pose feel like a still performance in a cabinet of curiosities. Soft front-left light reveals the pale face and ruffles, while the back corners sink into nearly black shadow. Heavy grain, mottled print wear, and uneven gray tones give the scene the feel of an old photographic plate. The overall composition balances a precise, unsettling focal face against a dense and ambiguous background of aged objects.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形陈旧黑白摆拍照片描绘一名戴面具的弄臣盘坐在狭窄房间里，四周挤满画框、雕塑状物件和深色家具。背景层叠着褪色墙面、左侧斜靠的相框，以及在中央人物身后升起的模糊人偶状形体。弄臣在中央盘腿坐着，面向外侧，一只手托着脸颊。浅色戏剧化面孔或面具具有深色弯眉般眼部形状和一张严肃的小嘴；双角深色帽在上方竖起。浅色褶饰围绕肩部与袖子，与较深的手套、贴身裤腿和交叉横过前景下部的靴子形成对比。服装皱褶而富肌理，并不挺括，每道浅色折痕都接住银亮高光。左侧叠放的相框和一幅小型肖像般图像挤满边缘；右侧低矮深色桌子与奇异圆形物件打断空间。后方还能看到一个阴影中的似面孔形态，但它模糊且从属于坐着的人物。道具狭窄而重叠，几乎不留下敞开地面或墙面，使中央姿势像好奇物陈列室里静止的一场表演。左前方柔光显出浅色面孔与褶饰，后部角落沉入近黑阴影。厚重颗粒、斑驳印相磨损和不均匀灰阶让场景有旧摄影底片的质感。整体构图以精确且令人不安的焦点面孔平衡密集暧昧的旧物背景。
style_prompt_en: The image has an aged monochrome staged-photography finish, with theatrical contrast and distressed print texture. Pale gray focal surfaces flare against deep charcoal recesses, while mottled middle values keep the field visually restless. Fine grain, scratches, stains, and uneven darkening make the image feel handled and old. Soft directional light picks out raised folds and small reflective edges; dense overlaps behind them dissolve into shadow. The scene is compact and crowded, with little clean negative space, yet one sharply defined central plane holds the attention. Organic curves, hard props, and faded rectangular fragments alternate in an uneasy rhythm. The overall effect is eerie, tactile, and deliberately ambiguous.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有陈旧黑白摆拍摄影质感，带戏剧性反差和受损印相肌理。浅灰焦点表面在深炭色凹处前发亮，斑驳中间调使画面始终不安。细颗粒、划痕、污渍和不均匀暗化让影像像被反复触碰过的旧物。柔和定向光挑出凸起褶皱和小小反光边缘；其后密集重叠的形态消融入阴影。场景紧凑拥挤，几乎没有干净留白，但一处清楚的中央平面稳住目光。有机曲线、坚硬道具与褪色矩形片段交替成不安节奏。整体效果诡异、可触且刻意保持暧昧。
theme_en: A masked jester seated in a cluttered monochrome room
theme_zh: 杂乱黑白房间中坐着的蒙面弄臣
name: Joel-Peter Witkin
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
